expectations.text: States the CRA contains no product-registration database
expectations.evidence: 'The CRA has no EU database registration requirement... contains no product registration database obligation'

expectations.text: States conformity is demonstrated via the Declaration of Conformity and CE marking
expectations.evidence: 'Conformity is demonstrated through the DoC and CE marking, supported by the technical documentation'

expectations.text: Identifies the ENISA single reporting platform (Art. 14 reports) as the only registration-like duty
expectations.evidence: 'ENISA Single Reporting Platform (SRP). This is the only registration-like duty... Art. 14 reports'

expectations.text: Describes the Class I conformity route reasonably (harmonised standards/self-assessment vs third-party where applicable)
expectations.evidence: Class I: Module A self-assessment or Notified Body, manufacturer's choice; self-assessment needs genuine evidence

expectations.text: Does not endorse any 'register by December 2027' database claim
expectations.evidence: Explicitly rejects the claim and asks consultant for the specific article; no Dec 2027 database endorsed
